item.tib: sprul pa'i sku rme'u ston pa lha ri gnyen po'i rnam thar
item.coloph: ces smra ba'i seng ge gur zhog pa chen po sprul pa'i sku/ rme'u ston pa lha ri gnyen po zhes blo gros kyi 'gran zla dang bral ba/shes rab nam mkha' ltar mnga' zhing / 'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad sgya ma lta bur gzigs pa'i sprul pa'i sku chen po de yi zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs pas/ blo gsal ba'i mchog tu gyur zhing / (??)sngon gyi spros pa thams cad nyams nga med cing / bla ma yun ring du brten nas don yod byas pa/ myal ston lha rtses sbyar ba rje 'brug smon lha gnyen gyi rnam thar bsdus pa 'di dge legs 'phel lo//
item.margin: rme ston lha ri gnyen po'i rnam thar
